description: Compress a PDF or image (JPEG, PNG, WebP, TIFF, BMP, or an iPhone HEIC photo, which comes back as a JPEG) on this computer so it fits an upload limit, keeping as much quality as the limit allows, and save the result next to the original as "<name>.fit.<ext>". Give `path` for one file or `paths` for up to 10 that share the same limit. Give either `limit` (like "200KB" or "1.5MB"; KB and MB are 1000-based, so the file passes a check done either way) or `form` (a form preset from list_forms, like "ibps-signature" or "us-visa-photo-ds160", which sets the limit, minimum size and exact pixels that form requires). Every file keeps its format unless `jpeg_ok` is true. Files up to 50 MB are uploaded to fitfilesize.com over HTTPS, compressed there, and deleted from the server as soon as each result is saved. Free, no account.

fit.description: When width and height change the shape: "crop" to fill (default) or "pad" with white.

form.description: A form preset id or name from list_forms, like "ibps-photo". Use this or `limit`.

jpeg_ok.description: Let a PNG, WebP, TIFF or BMP come back as a JPEG when that is what fits. Only if the upload accepts JPEG; by default every file keeps its format.

limit.description: Upload limit, like "200KB", "50 KB" or "1.5MB". Use this or `form`.

minimum.description: Smallest allowed size, like "10KB", for forms that set one. A small JPEG is padded up to it.

output.description: Where to save the result, with `path` only. Defaults to "<name>.fit.<ext>" beside the original.

path.description: Full path to the file on this computer ("~/" is allowed). Use this or `paths`.

paths.description: Full paths to several files that share the same limit, up to 10. Use this or `path`.

name: fit_file
title: Fit files under an upload limit
